find_creators.description: Find user-generated-content (UGC) creators in Germany, Austria and Switzerland by describing what you need in plain words, in English or German: 'beauty creator over 30 for a TikTok product video'. Narrow it by topic or city if you like. Each creator comes back with their rate, reach and social links, best match first; contact details are never included.
find_creators.name: find_creators

parameters.description: Describe the creator and the content you need, in English or German. The more you say (audience, platform, kind of video) the better the matches.

examples.label: Beauty video
examples.value: Beauty creator for a TikTok product video

examples.label: Food content
examples.value: Food creator for Instagram Reels with recipes

parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only creators who list at least one of these topics. Pick up to 10 from the list or type your own; the directory is mostly German, so German words (Reisen, Haustiere) find more. Leave empty for every topic.
parameters.name: topics

parameters.description: Only creators whose city contains this text. Most creators list no city because UGC is usually filmed remotely, so leave it empty unless you need someone on site.
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: Only creators whose profile links at least one portfolio and one social account, so you can see their work before contacting them.
parameters.name: portfolio_only

parameters.description: How many creators to return, best match first.
parameters.name: max_results

count.description: How many creators are in this list.

creators.description: The best-matching creators, best match first.

city.description: Where the creator is based, as they wrote it. Empty for most creators, since UGC is usually filmed remotely.

creator_id.description: The creator's UGC VZ ID, such as UGC-DCB40DFF9F. Give it to Get a creator for the full profile.

has_portfolio.description: Whether the profile links at least one portfolio and one social account.

name.description: The name the creator shows on their profile.

rate.description: The creator's rate in their own words, usually in euros per video.

reach.description: The creator's audience in their own words, per social network.

social_links.description: Links to the creator's social accounts.

total_reach.description: The creator's reach across their networks, added up as one number.

total_matches.description: How many creators in the directory matched before the list was cut to the number asked for.

get_creator.description: Get one creator's full public profile: topics, the kinds of content they make, equipment, experience, rate, reach, social accounts and portfolio links. Profiles are written by the creators themselves, mostly in German. Contact details are never included.

get_creator.name: get_creator

parameters.description: The creator's UGC VZ ID, such as UGC-DCB40DFF9F. Find creators returns it for each creator.
parameters.name: creator_id

city.description: Where the creator is based, as they wrote it. Empty for most creators, since UGC is usually filmed remotely.

country.description: Two-letter country code: DE, AT or CH.

creator_id.description: The creator's UGC VZ ID, such as UGC-DCB40DFF9F. Give it to Get a creator for the full profile.

equipment.description: The filming equipment the creator has.

experience_since.description: When the creator started making UGC, as month/year.

gender.description: The gender the creator gave: Female, Male or Non-binary.

has_portfolio.description: Whether the profile links at least one portfolio and one social account.

industries.description: The industries the creator has worked with, in their own words.

name.description: The name the creator shows on their profile.

portfolio_links.description: Links to examples of the creator's work.

preferred_content.description: The kinds of content the creator likes making, such as unboxings or reviews.

profile_image_url.description: A link to the creator's profile photo.

rate.description: The creator's rate in their own words, usually in euros per video.

reach.description: The creator's audience in their own words, per social network.

handle.description: The account name on that network.

platform.description: The network, such as instagram or tiktok.

special_traits.description: Anything that sets the creator apart, in their own words.

stage_name.description: The creator's stage name, if they gave one.

topics.description: The topics the creator makes content about.

total_reach.description: The creator's reach across their networks, added up as one number.

list_topics_and_cities.description: List the topics, industries and cities that creators in the directory mention most often, most common first. Useful for choosing what to search for, or for looping over topics.
list_topics_and_cities.display_str_template: List UGC VZ topics and cities.
list_topics_and_cities.name: list_topics_and_cities

cities.description: Cities creators list most often, most common first. Any of them can go into Find creators' City.

industries.description: Industries creators say they've worked with, most common first.

topics.description: Topics creators list most often, most common first. Any of them can go into Find creators' Topics.

description: Find user-generated-content (UGC) creators in Germany, Austria and Switzerland with UGC VZ, a free creator directory. Describe the creator you need in plain words and get matches with their rates, reach and social links, open a creator's full profile, and see the topics and cities creators list most.
